replies.author: Tazz
replies.body:
He's not harassing you. You replied to his comment, and he replied back stating a fact. Although he isn't being overly pleasant or nice to you Max, it is not really harassment. He did it once and it is not continuous and therefore it is not punishable, nor does it warrant a forum ban in any way shape or form.

If he harasses you continuously, just report him again and don't reply to him.

Regards

Tazz// Avicus Moderator
